all_customers.query: SELECT * FROM customers ORDER BY customer_id

count_products.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM products

customers_by_country.query: SELECT country, COUNT(*) as customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC

avg_age_by_country.query: SELECT country, AVG(age) as avg_age FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY avg_age DESC

customer_orders.query: SELECT c.name, c.email, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY order_count DESC

order_details.query: SELECT o.order_id, c.name as customer_name, p.name as product_name, o.quantity, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY o.order_id
